evidence.reason: The cited failure mode still exists in the current code: two_slot_health calls _tick_value(effects) before invoking the observe callback. On a fresh host with no heartbeat.json, that read/parse path raises before the first-tick polling/timeout budget can run, so the health command can exit 2 instead of waiting for the runner to publish within the timeout. The adjacent wait_for_first_tick path likewise reaches health_observation, which calls _tick_value and _parse_iso without an initially-absent-heartbeat wait.
